claims.claim: A third-party repay with an explicit amount reduces the borrower's debt and does not move their collateral.
Aave rejects type(uint256).max from a caller repaying on behalf of another account.
A repay above the debt charges the rescuer only the debt.
The repay formula carries a live Aave position to its target health factor on Base and Arbitrum forks.
In a forced price crash on a Base fork, a position rescued at its trigger is not liquidatable, and the same position left alone is liquidated and pays the bonus.
The keeper does not broadcast a transaction unless its signature recovers to the derived rescuer.
